data.name: Srecko
data.gender_notes: Srecko is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A Slavic name meaning 'bringer of light'. It is derived from the Slavic word 'sreča' meaning 'happiness, joy'. This name is also associated with the mythological figure Srečko, who is believed to protect against evil and bring light into the world. The name Srecko carries the meaning “Bringer of Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Srecko usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
